officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: Official HÖ7 sources frame the stage around folklore, cultural landscape and several rest points. The description references Pälle Näver and Vättehult, story cabinets placed by Smålands Trädgård, Högarps kulturreservat, Hålebäcken with remains of an 18th-century water saw, and Jättabacken with giant Finn's viewpoint. Official rest points named in the HÖ7 description are west of Högarps kulturreservat, Hålebäcken and Jättabacken.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: This medium-difficulty stage continues from Högarps kulturreservat toward Lemnhult through a landscape where local folklore and cultural traces sit close to the route. The main-route facility clusters are late in the stage at Hålebäcken and Jättabacken: Hålebäcken has a shelter and fireplace near the old water-saw remains, while Jättabacken has a simple rest cabin, fireplace, toilet and a short spur to the viewpoint. Helvetets Håla and Trollebo badplats are useful nearby destinations near the Lemnhult end, but they should be treated as spurs or access context rather than the HÖ7 main line. No public drinking-water source was confirmed, and live fire-risk/fire-ban status should be checked before using any fireplace.

seasonalAndServiceNotes: JLT line 352 and 353 timetable PDFs checked cover 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14; no coming timetable was listed on 2026-04-29.
Both checked PDFs show helgfri måndag till fredag service and no weekend table. Line 352 includes schoolday/holiday weekday variants; line 353 includes schoolday-only markings.
Naturkartan's public-transport widget reportedly showed no stops for HÖ7/Lemnhult-type pages, so these endpoints should not be presented as good transit trailheads without planner verification.
No ferry access found. No train stop is close to either endpoint; practical onward hubs are by bus via Vetlanda, Virserum or Åseda depending on line.

Dogs should be leashed/under extra control 1 March-20 August and leashed near grazing animals; close gates and avoid cow pastures with dogs when possible.

agents.summary: Confirmed official metadata, official narrative, endpoint continuity, official facility IDs, Högarps by and Helvetets håla official context.
Validated official GPX/API v2 as navigation-grade, checked endpoint continuity and ruled out stale OSM/legacy Stenberga-Lemnhult geometry.
Built HÖ7 facility inventory around Högarp, Hålebäcken, Jättabacken, Helvetets Håla and Trollebo; flagged no potable water, duplicate toilets and waste uncertainty.
Identified sparse line 353 access near Högarp start, weak Lemnhult endpoint access via line 352 stops 4.77-5.09 km away, and parking/access caveats.
Found no current HÖ7-specific field report; recorded weak 2024 legacy-route signal and persistent stale route naming.
Confirmed Högarps by and Helvetets håla rules, dynamic fire-risk/fire-ban caveats, dog/livestock cautions, no HÖ7 closure and Storm Dave currentness risk.
